- SOC 2: please share the latest SOC 2 report (or summary) and any gaps since the last audit.

Priya / Marissa / Kate — attaching the items Omnia requested. Short summary below and notes on scope/constraints.

Attachments included: redwood_soc2_summary_2025.pdf, ir_runbook_excerpt.txt, bcp_dr_sample.pdf

Summary / answers:
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (security & availability) audit, most recent coverage period ended 2025-11-30. Attached is a one-page summary plus pointer to our auditor letter. Full report is available under NDA — we can begin the NDA process immediately if Omnia requests it.
- Breach notification SLA: Redwood operational policy is to notify customers within 72 hours of confirming unauthorized access to customer data affecting personal data. We will provide a timeline template (attached IR playbook excerpt) that maps discovery -> containment -> customer notification. Note: we align notifications with incident classification workflows; "confirmation" is used intentionally to ensure accuracy and to avoid noisy false-positives.
- BCP/DR: sample BCP/DR attached includes RTO targets for model-serving endpoints (primary API failover: 5 min median for internal failover; full regional recovery RTO: 4 hours; RPO: up to 15 minutes for cached KV-sync scenarios). We include test cadence and runbook excerpts.
- GDPR/HIPAA: encryption in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). We provide subprocessors list via our public registry (link below) and will share a redacted copy for procurement. For HIPAA, we support BAAs and have a standard DPA + HIPAA addendum; legal can work through redlines.

Open items for Omnia to confirm:
1) Do you require the full SOC 2 report now (NDA), or is the summary sufficient for procurement?
2) Any specific RTO/RPO thresholds tighter than our sample?
3) Preferred contact for a brief IR walkthrough call (we can do 30 minutes PDT tomorrow).

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security
Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai

Attachment list: redwood_soc2_summary_2025.pdf; ir_runbook_excerpt.txt; bcp_dr_sample.pdf
